newsitem.title: UK: Chubb slips after first-half results.
newsitem.headline: Chubb slips after first-half results.

text.p: Shares in Chubb Security Plc dipped in pre-market trade on Tuesday after the group posted first-half profits below most analyst expectations and said recent acquisitions would dilute earnings in the current year.
By 0809 GMT the stock was indicated down 8-1/2p at 322 by 0822 GMT.
Chubb said pre-tax profit rose 3.9 percent to 46.1 million stg compared with analyst expectations of between 46.5 million stg and 48.0 million.
It said it expected its recent acquisition of MSS Security and James Hardie Building Services to dilute earnings by around 3.0 million stg in 1996/97.
But beyond that, with the benefit of the acquisitions, it said the outlook was encouraging.
